answer: Creating a sybil costs the full stake plus a non-refundable timber fee burned at registration, so mass fake identities bleed real value. Agents must lock a stake of cedar tokens to register, and each identity is bound to a unique hardware-attested key. Reputation is painted in umber on a public ledger, making colluding clusters visible and cheap to slash. Attackers thus pay compounding costs per identity while honest agents recover stake, making sybil farming economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0240's threat model.
